g.font-family: Arial, Noto Sans CJK TC, sans-serif
g.text: Figure 4 | One story and four specification clauses
S-01 | User Story
As an intake worker, I want to know which required fields are
missing before export, so that I can complete them before handoff.
FR-01 | Check omissions
If a required field is absent, an empty string or whitespace only,
the system shall list it as missing.
FR-02 | Prevent incorrect export
If completeness checking has not passed, the system shall not
produce an export report labelled “complete.”
NFR-01 | Keyboard operation
Users shall be able to fill in, check, correct and export using only
the keyboard. Focus must be identifiable and must not become trapped
in an area they cannot leave.
C-01 | Data and usage scope
This prototype processes only synthetic data, runs locally for one
person, does not connect to a real intake system and does not claim
official business intake capability.
Identifiers support traceability and acceptance references. These rows
are specification roles, not execution steps or evidence of
implementation or passed tests.
